claim: As VAP-r3-03, at V03: T-V3-40 (b) (V03 l. 2899) 'each building of a returned district draws its damage at the look's `lookLevel` … and at its own level outside them, after the hand-over (`crisisLookYields`), with Show crises off and at a key that withholds the condition'. The disaster's condition is `public` (DR44; R3-13), so no key withholds it: the clause asks for a fixture that cannot exist, and a key built to omit the condition finds the look drawn and the clause failing a correct build.
required_change: T-V3-40 (b) reads '… and at its own level outside them, after the hand-over (`crisisLookYields`) and with Show crises off; under View as at `public`, `local` and `secret` the same drawing, the condition `public` (§7.7's DR44); …'. V03 §5.6 (4)'s and (5)'s general sentences on a withheld condition stand (a `none`-row condition draws no look).

claim: V03 §5.6 (4) (l.2734-2735) reads 'a building the aftermath really ruins enters a decay run (V03 §3.11) and draws its own level from that epoch's week'. V06 §3.23 (1) starts the run at the week its change shows (the hazard's week; a `vacate`'s `decay` Works' start), not the epoch's (VAT3-r3-06); `planDamage` reads V06's `decayLevel` and T-V3-40 does not encode the week, so nothing built changes.
required_change: V03 §5.6 (4): 'draws its own level from that epoch's week' → 'draws its own level from the week its change shows (V06 §3.23 (1))'.

claim: The same one-ended hook as VV12-r3-01, at V03: V03 §5.6 (4) (l. 2725) places a building under a disaster's look 'in a district V01's `disasterDistricts` returns, or at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE in an end of V07's'; §1b's damage-layer row (l. 303) reads 'V07's ends', and §3.18's look row (l. 2095) 'V07's ends as the units'. V07 §5.6 (3)'s `villageUnitPlots` names 'the buildings' damage (V02, V03)' as its reader and V01 §3.16 (1) names V03 §5.6. At an end-less thorp no building lies 'in an end', so V03 draws no plan damage on a struck toft group's buildings, against V07 §5.6 (3) ('every building on a returned unit's plots draws … V03's plan').
required_change: V03 §5.6 (4)'s "or at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE in an end of V07's" reads "or at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE on a plot V07's `villageUnitPlots(doc, unit)` gives a unit it returns (V07 §5.6 (3): its ends, or in an end-less thorp its toft groups)"; §1b's row reads "V07 §5.6 (3)'s units and `villageUnitPlots`" for "V07's ends"; §3.18's row reads "V07 §5.6 (3)'s units (ends, or an end-less thorp's toft groups), each building on the plots `villageUnitPlots` gives it" for "V07's ends as the units".

claim: V03 §5.6 (2)'s `PlanDamage` record (l. 2683) declares `look: ExteriorDamage['look']; // V02 §2.4's: the condition (null for a preview) and the calamity's type; null with no look`. V02 §2.4's field is now `pattern: 'fire' | 'flood' | 'scatter'`, V01's `DisasterSource.pattern` (R3-09 (c)); the type follows V02's record, so only the comment is stale (repair-r3-V02's hand-off to V03).
required_change: The comment reads "V02 §2.4's: the condition (null for a preview) and its pattern (V01's `DisasterSource.pattern`); null with no look".

claim: R3-09 (e): 'Every disaster fixture of the set is a calamity with its linked `reconstruction` condition' (a disaster look stands only through a none-row condition linked to a carried calamity, `event` `calamity`, V11 §3.25.9 l. 4567; a calamity linked to no condition draws no look). V03 §7's damage fixtures still stage 'a district of houses under a staged disaster `ConditionOverlay` (§2.7: its weeks and severity)' (l. 2844–2845), and T-V3-40 runs 'on the damage fixtures' district under its disaster condition' (l. 2899); V04's T-V4-82 (i) already names its fixture so.
required_change: V03 §7: 'a district of houses ruined by a fixture calamity through its linked `reconstruction` condition's `ConditionOverlay` (V08 §3.16 (7) (b): `event` `calamity`; §2.7: its weeks and severity) and under a `disaster` preview'; T-V3-40: 'on the damage fixtures' district under its calamity's linked `reconstruction` condition and under a `disaster` preview'.

claim: Round 3 rewrote `PlanDamage.own`'s comment (V03 l. 2682): 'V06's decayLevel(doc, lineage, week) alone; 0 for a standing building outside a run (V06 §3.23 (2))'. A building reoccupied under a `repair` Works is standing and outside its run (the run lasts 'until a restoring event', V06 §3.23 (1)), yet its level is L × (1 − f(w)) until FINISHED (V06 §3.23 (3)) — the weeks in which (b)'s repaired elements leave. The field's definition is right; the gloss names the wrong value for that case.
required_change: V03 §5.6 (2), the `own` comment: 'V06's decayLevel(doc, lineage, week) alone; 0 for a standing building outside a run and any restoration (V06 §3.23 (2)–(3))'.
